text:
Lina: Quick thread to finalize observability scope for next cycle. We need a ship plan that balances: token-level cost visibility, sample-based error capture, and privacy-safe payload exports. Customers are asking for per-model + per-route token spend and quick incident sampling.

Omar: High-level constraints: on-prem/Dedicated customers can't send payloads off-cluster. Any export needs a disabled-by-default path or a local-only agent.

Priya: Proposed cut options: 1) Token spend table (per-model, per-route) with daily rollups + CSV/Parquet export. 2) Error sampler that stores redacted payloads and links to trace ids (configurable sample rate). 3) Alerts for spend spikes (threshold + anomaly detection) 1) and 2) are highest customer value.

Jonah: Effort estimates (rough): token rollups ~3 dev days + small infra job; sampler ~5 dev days + retention infra; anomaly alerts ~4 dev days + ML calibration.

Rohan: Storage/infra numbers: sampled payloads at 0.5% of traffic => ~10GB/day at current traffic. Redaction reduces size ~50%. Retention tiers: 3d (default), 30d (paid). Need billing for storage.

Priya: Privacy/legal: any payload export must run a redaction step and optionally hash prompt text. Legal wants an opt-in checklist for customers that will export raw payloads. We'll route review to legal-bot.

legal-bot: Reminder: Exports containing potential PII require documented customer consent and data processing agreement update when retention > 7 days. Mark as blocker if we plan default raw export.

Lina: Given that, proposed minimum ship: A) Token spend daily rollups + export (CSV/Parquet) with role-based access. B) Error sampler (redacted by default, hash option) with 3-day retention. C) Spend-alerts as alpha behind feature flag. Defer full anomaly ML until next cycle.

Omar: For Dedicated/private: implement agent that writes sampled traces to a customer-configured S3/GCS or local path. Feature flag off by default for private clusters.

Priya: Acceptance criteria for each item:
- Token spend: daily rollup present in console, export format examples, unit tests for aggregation, accuracy within 0.5% vs raw billing.
- Error sampler: redaction validated (PII rules), sample rate adjustable via UI and API, links to trace ids, retention enforcement.
- Alerts: able to configure threshold, on-call routing, false-positive rate < 10% in pilot.

Jonah: Experiment plan: roll token-spend to 10% orgs first, collect correctness metrics and UX feedback for 2 weeks. Error sampler to internal customers + 3 pilot customers.

Rohan: Infra ops: we need a retention-enforcement batch job, lifecycle policies on object stores, and a quota/monitoring dashboard for sampled payload storage. Estimate 2 SRE days for runbook + quotas.

Omar: Implementation detail: compute token spend from tokenizer output emitted by inference runtime (cheap) vs post-hoc dedupe from billing events (more accurate). For MVP, use tokenizer output and correlate with request_id.

Priya: UI mocks: token spend table + sparklines, per-model dropdown, export button with options (CSV/Parquet, redacted/raw). Include a small inline explainer about sampling and privacy.

Lina: Risk register:
- Privacy/regulatory (blocked unless legal signs off for raw exports)
- Dedicated customer egress constraints (solve via agent)
- Perf impact if sampler runs synchronously (must be async)

Jonah: Perf guardrails: sampler must be async and non-blocking; p99 tail increase < 1ms for inference endpoints. We'll add perf tests to the acceptance checklist.

Priya: Quick config example for sampler we can put in README:
```
sampler:
  enabled: true
  sample_rate: 0.005  # 0.5%
  redaction: redact_text
  retention_days: 3
  export_destination: s3://customer-bucket/path  # optional for private
```

Lina: Action items: Omar+Rohan to produce infra cost estimate and dedicated-agent plan by EOD. Jonah to draft perf test harness and SLA gates. Priya to update PRD with legal checklist and UI mocks. I'll coordinate pilot customer invites.

infra-bot: Snapshot created for branch observability/token-sampler (build 5120). Disk quota for sampler testing: +25GB allocated to staging. :gear:

legal-bot: Added data-processing-review checklist to ticket OBS-4321. Please mark expected export behavior.

Omar: I'll prototype agent write-path for private deploys and a toggle to disable any outbound export.

Rohan: Will size retention and lifecycle policies; leaning 3d default, 30d premium. Need pricing input.

Lina: Thanks all. We'll reconvene at the 2pm roadmap call with recommended cut (my expectation: ship token rollups + redacted sampler + alpha alerts).

Priya: One more thing 1) include CSV/Parquet schema example in PRD and 2) include mapping for model aliases so customers can join with billing exports. I'll add both.

Lina: Perfect. Closing thread 1) keep comments here for any blockers before 2pm.
